description: ACT Government publishes this polyline inventory of municipal assets in the Australian Capital Territory. The mapped assets include concrete and grass channels, swales, floodways and spillways. The provider describes attributes for channel material, shape, dimensions, grade, length and upstream and downstream invert levels. Assets are captured through works-as-executed handover or field audits. Coverage is limited to assets owned or managed by the named ACT government services; private, federal and other directorate assets may be absent. The Socrata catalogue and JSON view metadata are public and free to inspect. The native listing does not state a licence. Caveats: only metadata was inspected, no dataset rows or geometry values were downloaded. Field definitions do not establish field completeness or current asset condition. For infrastructure simulation, geometry and channel dimensions can define drainage-network elements; flow series and hydraulic calibration are not established. Related catalogue: ACT Government open data portal.
